Chapter 1260: 17: The Great Demon Attacks The Mountain (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1260: Chapter 17: The Great Demon Attacks the Mountain (Seeking Subscription)

Lin Yuan serves as a keeper at the Qingyun Institute, mainly responsible for organizing ancient texts, books, and jade slips.

This type of position is quite relaxed.

Generally, it is those who have worked hard for the Holy Sect for many years and have established sufficient merits.

In the end, they are elders whose bodies have hidden troubles undertaking this role.

Although Lin Yuan is not very old, he once suffered from the erosion of Demonic Qi affecting his mind and gained the Sect Master’s approval.

Being a keeper has been quite smooth for him.

Actually, Lin Yuan also contributed to the Holy Sect by alerting about the issue of his elder brother falling into demonic ways early, helping the sect avoid great losses.

While restoring his strength, Lin Yuan is mainly researching the physical body; the potential of this body he descended into is too strong, almost as though—

It is like the direct descendant of a thirteenth-tier time life.

The potential is remarkably great.

In the Six Ancient Countries of the first Source World, the blood of six ancestors flows within all beings.

But it is incredibly thin, almost nonexistent.

Yet in this Fang Yuan World, the potential of the physical body is terrifyingly high.

“Before the great change of heaven and earth, the cultivation system of this Fang Yuan World was runes, interpreting everything in the world, including rules and the great way, using the form of runes.”

Lin Yuan gazes at the jade slip legacy left behind before the great change, his expression somewhat contemplative.

The Great Dao rules are originally formless, ordinary people can’t see or touch them; even cultivators can only touch them through feelings.

However, runes are tangible, interpreting the intangible Great Dao rules through visible runes… so before the heaven and earth changes, the number of cultivators in this world was frighteningly high.

With a foundation of numerous strong individuals, the possibility of birthing even stronger ones naturally increases.

Qingyun Saint Sect was the giant overlord of this area before the great change, with strong individuals of the Transcendent Realm keeping watch.

And the Transcendent Realm, even the first stage of Transcendent, benchmarks the Chaos Great Saint of the Chaos Void.

Yet after experiencing the great change and multiple massive demonic assaults on the sect, the strongest force of Qingyun Saint Sect is now at the Peak of Longevity Sixth Realm, which is the peak of the Chaos Realm.

With the support of the Sect Protection Array of Qingyun Saint Sect, it can barely exhibit defenses at the Transcendent Realm level; which is why Qingyun Saint Sect can withstand multiple massive demonic assaults.

The Great Demon, directly on par with the terrifying ‘demon’ at the Peak of Longevity Sixth Realm, and even surpassing Longevity Sixth Realm in certain aspects.

“After the great change of heaven and earth, Demonic Qi pervades, the Great Dao rules are unmanifested, and even with rune legacy, it’s hard to perfectly interpret the vague Great Dao rules.”

Lin Yuan senses the deep aura of power permeating between heaven and earth, his eyes suddenly brightening, “Runes?”

In Lin Yuan’s palm, strands of aura weave, and in an instant form the character ‘Gold’.

This ‘Gold’ is the text of this world’s essence, belonging fundamentally to the Gold Rune, perfectly explaining everything about the Golden Rules.

“Marvelous, marvelous, marvelous!”

Lin Yuan exclaims with high spirits.

Speaking of runes, the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, collected in the Six Ancient Countries’ treasury in the first Source World, is essentially runes.

And the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, left from a high-level perspective by an ancestor, even Lin Yuan had great difficulty replicating it.

However, the rune legacy of this world can engrave everything within this world, transmuting the intangible into tangible; thus greatly reducing the difficulty of understanding, offering infinite possibilities.

“With runes as a foundation, I now know how to sustain the development of the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts rapidly turn, as the true self of the first Source World attempts to mimic the Abyss Dragon, creating vast worlds within each of his own particles.

That Abyss Dragon, in terms of foundation, is still above Lin Yuan, relying on what? Isn’t it just the endless sand-like particle worlds?

If Lin Yuan can also smoothly imitate this, creating Constant Sand Particle Worlds, and then reconstruct them sequentially using the “Infinite Void” legacy, then the ultimate power… Lin Yuan doesn’t dare to imagine.

At least far surpassing the current state.

…

“That Abyss Dragon is able to simultaneously sustain Constant Sand Particle Worlds relying on innate talent, as the first born of primal life, a talent gifted by Source World.”

“But I don’t have this talent, so I can only rely on mind power to sustain the development of particle worlds. Yet mind power is limited, while Constant Sand Particle Worlds are limitless.”

Lin Yuan rapidly thinks to himself, the emergence of rune legacy made him see hope for simultaneously sustaining Constant Sand Particle Worlds.

Engrave the Great Dao rules runes on the surface of each particle world to stabilize the particle worlds, ultimately giving rise to endless Constant Sand Particle Worlds.

“At present, this method seems the simplest and most hopeful.”

Lin Yuan secretly considers, as the true self of the first Source World repeatedly analyzes, he hasn’t found a better way, either unsustainable long-term, or having too great a risk.

Now, this world’s rune legacy inadvertently perfectly aligns with Lin Yuan’s development of his own Constant Sand Particle Worlds.

“It’s not inconsequential; the rune legacy inherently aligns with any cultivation system, using runes to replicate the Great Dao rules and even have the world feedback itself, simply an ideal auxiliary method.”

Lin Yuan thinks inwardly.

“Start trying to develop particle worlds from this world.”

Lin Yuan decides internally, the potential of this physical body is sufficiently high, completely capable of accommodating the development of multiple particle worlds.

Even if it fails in the process, Lin Yuan has already arranged means to preserve life and revive, capable of starting all over again.

Secondly, developing particle worlds from weak to strong allows better perception of the operation of each world, greatly benefiting Lin Yuan’s true self cultivation.
